Level1: The dead walk again. A horde of undead has overrun the outer village, and your party stands as the last line of defense. Steel your nerves — this is only the beginning.
Level2: You pushed them back, but the threat grows. Goblin scouts have been spotted moving through the ruins, emboldened by the chaos. Root them out before they rally.
Level3: The source of the corruption lies ahead. One final stand. Whatever awaits you in the depths, you face it together. There is no retreat.
